# Net Core AI

Net Core AI is a premium custom web development agency based in Dallas, Texas.
We build high-performance websites and web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern tooling.
We do not use templates, WordPress, or page builders — every project is written from scratch.

## Services

- **Custom Website Development** — fully custom-coded websites from $800, delivered in 1–2 weeks
- **Monthly Retainer Plans** — ongoing maintenance, security, SEO, and content updates from $50/month
- **AI Lead Conversion Chatbot** — custom-trained AI chatbot to qualify leads 24/7 ($500 one-time setup)
- **Analytics & Management Dashboard** — real-time traffic, conversions, and lightweight CMS ($100/month)
